informal_statement:
There is a four-arc candidate with curvature \(h\), angle
\[
\arccos(h/\lambda),
\]
density jump
\[
\lambda>1,
\]
and incidence
\[
\lambda\cos\alpha=h,
\]
whose assembled coordinate set equals \(C_h\). The region satisfies all stated regularity properties and
\[
A_\lambda(C_h)=A_4(h),
\]

\[
P_\lambda(C_h)=P_4(h).
\]
For
\[
y=\pm1,
\]
points with
\[
|x|<\sin(\arccos(h/\lambda))/h
\]
are interior to \(C_h\). The reflected cap is contained in
\[
y\leq-1.
\]
